status: protocol drafted; mission-level dataset/query freeze and owner approval still required
question: Do R-GCN or CompGCN improve bilingual question-to-graph retrieval over text-only and source-witnessed neighborhoods?

dataset.source: Wikidata Query Service bounded Norway organization extract
dataset.bilingual_label_coverage: 2067/2157 entities have en/no/nb/nn labels; 90 use identifier-only feature fallback
dataset.scope_assessment: Bounded organization-entity pilot; deterministic IRI-order selection is not representative and service-operator coverage is inadequate (one P137 edge).

features.node_text: Original Wikidata rdfs:label literals in en/no/nb/nn; preserve language and graph-qualified IRI; use identifier-only fallback for 90 unlabeled entity nodes
features.relation_text: Original Wikidata property labels for each direct-claim predicate; language tags retained

baseline_case_set.origin: Existing public #50 case set; machine-authored and source-audited, not human relevance gold
baseline_case_set.scope_limit: Existing public #50 questions and references are GEMET-only; no two-hop cases; not the final Wikidata GNN test set

measured_stage_one_baseline.judgment_limit: Public, exposed AI-authored references; not independent human gold and not a two-hop benchmark
measured_stage_one_baseline.scope_limit: Measured on GEMET, not on this selected Wikidata snapshot; do not compare as if matched.

shared.query_projection: linear 768-to-128; trained on training questions only
shared.retrieval_score: dot product between normalized projected question and graph-aware entity candidate
shared.message_direction: Aggregate only original RDF subject-to-object edges; no inverse triples
shared.directional_link_scoring: score_tails for original subject-to-object retrieval and score_heads for original object-to-subject retrieval; both use the same predicate IRI, and neither adds an inverse RDF triple

rgcn.message_passing: one relation-specific 128x128 transform per original predicate plus self transform

compgcn.message_passing: shared transform after entity-relation composition; update relation embeddings each layer

training.early_stopping: validation MRR@10; patience 10; restore best validation state
training.negative_sampling: 10 graph-local corrupted tails per observed training edge; filter known true triples; same negatives for both models
training.loss: equal-weight logistic link prediction and question-to-entity retrieval
training.message_passing_partition: training edges only; validation/test edges excluded from all encoder inputs
training.unseen_entity_analysis: separate run with all incident training edges removed for held-out entities; original labels remain available
training.execution: CPU only; no GPU, Metal or automatic download

comparison.candidate_pool: same graph-qualified concept universe for entity ranking; predicate and path candidates are scored in separate role-specific tasks
comparison.candidate_generation_and_reranking: log candidate recall before scoring; report GNN full-pool recall separately from any shared-pool reranking
comparison.prediction_semantics: Every GNN score is a hypothesis. A candidate ID must remain graph-qualified; only original RDF statements can support a displayed relationship; unsupported predicted links remain labeled unsupported and never become executable operations.
comparison.primary_proposed_criterion: CompGCN gains at least 10 absolute percentage points Recall@10 over the strongest text-only baseline, paired on the same cases.
comparison.structural_value_criterion: CompGCN must also have positive paired Recall@10 lift over deterministic source-neighborhood retrieval; report confidence interval and candidate recall.
comparison.safety_regressions: No source-unsupported triple presentation, no graph-scope crossing, no silent direction reversal, and no regression in exact-IRI preservation or no-match false suggestions.

resource_ceiling.device: CPU only, 4 intra-op threads, 1 inter-op thread

not_ready_reasons: no matched BM25/neighborhood baseline has been captured on this Wikidata snapshot
current #50 cases and references are GEMET-only and lack two-hop questions
Wikidata extract has only one P137 operator edge; service-focused coverage is incomplete
current references are AI-authored and exposed
no final grouped query/triple split freeze
M1 Pro resource preflight not run
no end-to-end feature tensor and GNN CLI run was executed because pinned PyTorch is absent from this environment
